initial_plan.answerability: partly: the data can compare the share of reported crashes involving at least one person injured or killed, but cannot measure the danger per trip or per vehicle-mile
initial_plan.metric: percentage of included reported crashes with number_of_persons_injured > 0 or number_of_persons_killed > 0
initial_plan.denominator: crashes with a usable date, a valid crash_time, and nonmissing values in both total-person outcome columns
initial_plan.population: police-reported NYC motor-vehicle crashes in all years represented by valid crash_date values
initial_plan.years: all years represented by valid crash_date values in the file
initial_plan.grouping: Night = crash_time from 20:00 through 05:59; day = 06:00 through 19:59

data_check_decisions.scope_change: Use only complete calendar years 2013-2025 to compare both time-of-day groups across the same complete-year range and avoid the highly incomplete total-person outcomes in partial 2026.
data_check_decisions.year_exclusions: Exclude 136,969 valid-date rows from 2012 and 2026 (6.036038% of all valid-date rows): 2012 covers only July 1-December 31 and 2026 only January 1-June 11; total-person killed is missing for 8,877 of 36,424 rows in 2026.
data_check_decisions.outcome_exclusions: Within 2013-2025, exclude 42 of 2,132,218 candidate rows with either total-person outcome column missing (18 missing injured and 36 missing killed, with overlap), rather than treating unknown as no casualties.
data_check_decisions.impossible_outcomes: No negative values were found in either total-person outcome column in the 2013-2025 candidate rows.
data_check_decisions.time_values: Keep all 23,787 rows in 2013-2025 with crash_time 00:00:00 because midnight is a valid time; disclose the possible default-time pile-up.
data_check_decisions.date_time_quality: There are no missing crash dates or times in the candidate rows used for these years, and no impossible nonmissing typed TIME values.

final_plan.answerability: partly: measures the chance that a reported crash had at least one injured or killed person, conditional on being a reported crash, not street or trip risk
final_plan.metric: Percentage of included reported crashes where number_of_persons_injured > 0 or number_of_persons_killed > 0
final_plan.denominator: 2,132,176 police-reported crashes with valid date and time and nonmissing values in both total-person outcome columns, during complete calendar years 2013-2025
final_plan.population: Police-reported NYC motor-vehicle crashes from 2013 through 2025, with known total-person injury and death counts and a valid recorded crash time
final_plan.limitations: The denominator is reported crashes, not trips, people exposed, traffic volume, or vehicle-miles, so the result cannot establish exposure-adjusted danger. Years are pooled without year adjustment. The 23,787 recorded-midnight crashes in scope are retained although midnight may be a default-time pile-up; 42 crashes missing total-person outcome fields are excluded. Partial 2012 and 2026 are excluded; file dates end 2026-06-11.
